t: Mapei Mapesil AC 114 is a high-performance, solvent-free silicone sealant, specifically engineered for creating durable, watertight seals. This anthracite silicone sealant is a reliable choice for trade professionals, ideal for sanitaryware installations including wash basins, bath tubs, and shower trays, plus effective sealing around window frames. Its advanced formulation ensures it is both waterproof and highly resistant to mould and mildew, crucial for high-moisture environments such as bathrooms and kitchens. Suitable for both interior and exterior use, even underwater, it offers robust chemical resistance and tolerates temperatures up to 180°C, colour coordinating with the Mapei Ultracolour Plus Grout range for a consistent finish.
b: Suitable for Sanitaryware, Wash Basins, Bath Tubs, Shower Trays & Window Frames
